$$ダバラーン$$
「Looks like you're protecting that giant battleship.」

$$ロジャー$$
「So he's set his sights on the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$...!」

474:t_003:8.en:
$$葵$$
「He's $$エルーナルーナ$$'s right hand for a reason...! His eye for tactics is the real deal!」

474:t_003:9.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「All units, target that battleship! I don't know why, but doing what the enemy hates is the iron rule of tactics!」

474:t_003:10.en:

「I'll do some scouting in the meantime.」

474:t_004:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm glad we didn't have to fight that guy, but he left us some troublesome orders.」

474:t_004:1.en:
$$ミカ$$
「Analysis of the enemy units indicates the pilots are probably $$インセクト$$s.」

474:t_004:2.en:
$$アキラ$$
「This is the worst! Breakthrough tactics are right up their alley!」

474:t_004:3.en:
$$ナオト$$
「Tch! He brought expendable pawns to analyze our strength!」

474:t_004:4.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「The $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ can't move right now! Let's intercept the enemies closing in on us first!」

474:t_004:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Will you be all right on your own, $$甲児$$?」

474:t_004:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$隼人$$ and $$弁慶$$ need to stay with $$竜馬$$! I'll fill the hole in the $$ゲッター$$ Team!」

474:t_004:9.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Can you hear that, $$竜馬$$? Everyone is fighting to protect you.」

474:t_004:11.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Don't worry! We won't let anyone lay a finger on the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$!」

474:t_004:13.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, begin the attack. Defend the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ to the death.」

474:t_004:14.en:
$$甲児$$
「($$竜馬$$... Now it's our turn to protect you...!)」

474:t_005:0.en:
$$凱$$
「Looks like we got through that somehow...」

474:t_006:0.en:
$$凱$$
「All right! The $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ took no damage!」

474:t_007:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They've appeared, drawn by the $$ゲッター線$$!」

474:t_009:3.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Jumping into the fight without warning, just like him.」

474:t_009:4.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「But why is he in the $$ブラックゲッター$$?」

474:t_010:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Tch... The $$竜馬$$ we see now... is not the $$竜馬$$ we know.」

474:t_010:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「The $$ゲッター線$$ healed him, but it seems his aggressive instinct and destructive urge have grown out of proportion.」

474:t_010:6.en:
$$弁慶$$
「That guy... punched me and $$隼人$$, then took off in a $$ゲッター$$...」

474:t_010:7.en:
$$青山$$
「Aggressive instinct and destructive urge...? That's just like the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s...!」

474:t_010:9.en:
$$隼人$$
「Most likely he now sees everything in front of him as an enemy.」

474:t_010:10.en:
$$万丈$$
「So he's indiscriminate toward the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s and us alike.」

474:t_010:11.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But knowing him, he will most likely go after us first, as the stronger presence.」

474:t_010:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「He and I fought side by side on the $$新日本$$ Front, after all.」

474:t_010:16.en:
$$凱$$
「The way he is, words won't get through to him!」

474:t_010:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「We can get our feelings across even without words...!」

474:t_010:21.en:
$n
「It's $$竜馬$$ we're up against, after all. So fighting is how we communicate.」

474:t_010:22.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「For once, I agree as well. Since our opponent is him.」

474:t_010:23.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Got it! $$ノノ$$ will talk it out with $$竜馬$$ using her fists too!」

474:t_010:24.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Got it! $$ノノ$$ will talk it out with $$竜馬$$ using her fists too!」

474:t_010:25.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Got it! $$ノノ$$ will talk it out with $$竜馬$$ using her fists too!」

474:t_010:26.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Nonsense. What is the point of that?」

474:t_010:27.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But he's really coming to crush us! We have no choice but to fight back!」

474:t_010:28.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Our target is the $$ブラックゲッター$$...」

474:t_010:29.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Fighting the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s while taking on the famous $$流竜馬$$ as well, this is going to be tough.」

474:t_010:30.en:
$$葵$$
「But it's not bad... My blood's starting to boil...!」

474:t_010:33.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Getting a little rough is fine! Knock some sense into him and wake $$竜馬$$ up!」

474:t_010:34.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Anyone who gets in my way... I will destroy them ALL!!」

474:t_010:35.en:
$$甲児$$
「Here I come, $$竜馬$$!! I'll stop you with the fighting style you taught me!!」

474:t_011:1.en:
$$號$$
「No good! This much won't stop him!」

474:t_012:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$ブラックゲッター$$'s $$ゲッター$$ Reactor is about to go out of control!」
